authorInfo.bio: Christoph von Schmid (1768–1854) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Wolf-slayer; [Margaret Kaurner]" by Christoph von Schmid is a collection of two moralistic tales likely written in the early 19th century. The book follows the story of a brave young boy named George who actively seeks to protect his community from a menacing wolf and also narrates the experiences of a young girl, Margaret, as she navigates life in the city while remaining devoted to her family virtues.
